role: Read-only readiness audit and prior-checkpoint commit observation; not fresh proof authority, Alpha admission, or deployment.

precommit_sanity.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c 'import hashlib,json,re,resource,signal,time
from pathlib import Path
resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(170,175))
signal.alarm(180)
started=time.monotonic()
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/"research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-gcd-closure-v1"
summary=json.loads((base/"completion-accounting-v1.json").read_text())
audit=json.loads((base/"independent-final-verification-audit-v1.json").read_text())["final16"]["report"]
execution=json.loads((base/"final-verification-observations-v1.json").read_text())
assert summary["complete_checkpoint_acceptance"] and len(execution["records"])==16
assert summary["source_inventory"]["final_verification_source_binding"]==audit["source_binding"]==execution["source_binding"]
assert summary["artifact"]["sha256"]==audit["artifact"]["sha256"]==execution["artifact_sha256"]
assert summary["focused_tests"]["distinct_cases"]==938 and summary["focused_tests"]["passed_phase_count"]==2814
assert summary["definitions_and_dag"]["all_theorem_ast_roundtrips_exact"]
pins={}
def collect(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        if isinstance(value.get("path"),str) and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}",value.get("sha256","")):
            path=value["path"]
            if path in pins: assert pins[path]["sha256"]==value["sha256"]
            pins[path]=value
        for child in value.values(): collect(child)
    elif isinstance(value,list):
        for child in value: collect(child)
collect(summary)
collect(audit["checked_literal_inputs"])
collect(audit["controls"])
checked=[]
for name,pin in sorted(pins.items()):
    path=root/name
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    size=0
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        while True:
            block=stream.read(1024*1024)
            if not block: break
            digest.update(block);size+=len(block)
    assert digest.hexdigest()==pin["sha256"],name
    if "bytes" in pin: assert size==pin["bytes"],name
    checked.append(dict(path=name,bytes=size,sha256=digest.hexdigest()))
docs=[root/"PLAN/28_recursive_polynomial_gcd_bezout.md",base/"README.md",root/"research/arithmetic-library/working/prime-field-gcd-existence-v1/README.md"]
links=[]
for path in docs:
    text=path.read_text()
    assert all(line==line.rstrip(" \t") for line in text.splitlines()),path
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",text):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"): continue
        destination=(path.parent/target.split("#",1)[0]).resolve()
        assert destination.exists(),(path,target)
        links.append(dict(source=str(path.relative_to(root)),target=target))
for entry in execution["records"]:
    assert entry["exit_code"]==0
    assert "".join(part["output"] for part in entry["parts"])==entry["stdout"]
    assert json.loads(entry["stdout"].strip().splitlines()[-1])==entry["report"]
    assert entry["report"]["source_binding"]==audit["source_binding"]
assert not summary["publication"]["alpha_admission_performed"]
assert not summary["publication"]["commit_performed"]
assert not summary["theorem_scope"]["full_G091_prime_power_field_construction_proved"]
payload=(base/"completion-accounting-v1.json").read_bytes()
print(json.dumps(dict(kind="completion-documentation-and-pin-sanity",pins_checked=len(checked),checked_pins=checked,local_links_checked=len(links),links=links,actual_final_records_reconciled=16,complete_accounting_bytes=len(payload),complete_accounting_sha256=hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),source_binding=audit["source_binding"],proof_calls=0,seconds=time.monotonic()-started,peak_rss_bytes=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss),sort_keys=True))
'
